snapshot.reason: Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited's board approved a Scheme of Arrangement with Dalmia Bharat Refractories Limited, which could lead to strategic benefits and value creation.
snapshot.why_now: The Board Meeting approving the Scheme of Arrangement was held on September 21, 2026, providing a clear catalyst for the company's strategic direction.
source_headlines: Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited: Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited has informed the Exchange about Scheme of Arrangement between Dalmia Bharat Refractories Limited ( Demerged Company ) and Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd ( Resulting Company ) and their respective shareholders and creditors under Section 230-232 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013
